resources.string: Showing subtitles over the TV\'s HDMI picture
CouchSubs subtitles stopped. Open CouchSubs again to turn them back on.
Overlay mode: subtitles appear over the TV\'s own HDMI picture.
No picture inside CouchSubs. Switching to overlay mode: subtitles appear over the TV\'s own HDMI picture.
Switch the TV to the PS5\'s input (HDMI %1$d) with the remote. Subtitles will appear on top.
Overlay mode needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.
The PS5 picture is not coming through inside CouchSubs. On some TVs it stays black here; overlay mode fixes this, but it needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.

CouchSubs on your computer grants it when it installs the TV app: start the translation there with USB debugging on. Or on the TV open Settings › Apps › Special app access › Display over other apps and turn on CouchSubs.
